mapper.update: UPDATE agent_tool_approval SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, run_id = #{runId}, tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}, tool_name = #{toolName}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, requester_user_id = #{requesterUserId}, approval_permission = #{approvalPermission}, safe_argument_summary = #{safeArgumentSummary}, request_ciphertext = #{requestCiphertext}, decision_status = #{decisionStatus}, execution_status = #{executionStatus}, version = version + 1, reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, requested_at = #{requestedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, execution_started_at = #{executionStartedAt}, execution_completed_at = #{executionCompletedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND version = #{version}
